{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
count_neg1 = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {count_neg1}')

# Check revenue format
print('\nFirst few revenue values:')
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f'\nNumber of rows with revenue == "999999.99": {qa_count}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')"}
